question: How many countries does the surveillance graph cover?
cypher: MATCH (c:Country) RETURN count(c) AS countries

question: What are the WHO regions and their codes?
cypher: MATCH (r:Region) RETURN r.who_code AS code, r.name AS region ORDER BY code

question: Which disease indicators are tracked?
paraphrases: List the notifiable diseases in the graph.
cypher: MATCH (d:Disease) RETURN d.indicator_code AS code, d.name AS disease ORDER BY code

question: Which general health indicators are recorded, and how many observations each?
cypher: MATCH (h:HealthIndicator) RETURN h.indicator_code AS code, h.name AS indicator, count(h) AS observations ORDER BY observations DESC, code

question: Which vaccine antigens have coverage records?
cypher: MATCH (v:VaccineCoverage) RETURN v.antigen AS antigen, count(v) AS records, min(v.year) AS first_year, max(v.year) AS last_year ORDER BY antigen

question: Which WHO region is {iso} in?
cypher: MATCH (c:Country {iso_code: $iso})-[:IN_REGION]->(r:Region) RETURN c.name AS country, r.name AS region

question: Which countries belong to the {code} region?
cypher: MATCH (c:Country)-[:IN_REGION]->(r:Region {who_code: $code}) RETURN c.name AS country ORDER BY country

question: How many countries carry no WHO region?
paraphrases: Data check: which countries are missing a region link?
cypher: MATCH (c:Country) WHERE NOT (c)-[:IN_REGION]->() RETURN count(c) AS without_region

question: How many country-year reports are there for each disease indicator?
cypher: MATCH (r:DiseaseReport)-[:REPORT_OF]->(d:Disease) RETURN d.name AS disease, count(r) AS reports ORDER BY reports DESC, disease

question: How many disease reports are not attributed to any country?
cypher: MATCH (r:DiseaseReport) WHERE NOT ()-[:REPORTED]->(r) RETURN count(r) AS unattributed

question: Which tracked disease indicators have no reports at all?
paraphrases: Data check: which diseases are defined but never reported?
cypher: MATCH (d:Disease) WHERE NOT (d)<-[:REPORT_OF]-() RETURN d.indicator_code AS code, d.name AS disease ORDER BY code

question: Which diseases has {iso} reported, and in how many years?
cypher: MATCH (c:Country {iso_code: $iso})-[:REPORTED]->(r:DiseaseReport)-[:REPORT_OF]->(d:Disease) RETURN d.name AS disease, count(r) AS reports, min(r.year) AS first_year, max(r.year) AS last_year ORDER BY disease

question: Which countries filed the most reports of {code}?
cypher: MATCH (c:Country)-[:REPORTED]->(r:DiseaseReport)-[:REPORT_OF]->(d:Disease {indicator_code: $code}) RETURN c.name AS country, count(r) AS reports ORDER BY reports DESC, country LIMIT 10

question: In which years were the most cholera cases reported worldwide?
cypher: MATCH (r:DiseaseReport)-[:REPORT_OF]->(d:Disease {indicator_code: 'CHOLERA_0000000001'}) RETURN r.year AS year, round(sum(r.value)) AS cases ORDER BY cases DESC, year LIMIT 5

question: What was the worldwide reported total of {code} in {year}?
cypher: MATCH (r:DiseaseReport)-[:REPORT_OF]->(d:Disease {indicator_code: $code}) WHERE r.year = $year RETURN d.name AS disease, round(sum(r.value)) AS total, count(r) AS reporting_countries

question: Which countries reported the highest totals of {code} across all years?
cypher: MATCH (c:Country)-[:REPORTED]->(r:DiseaseReport)-[:REPORT_OF]->(d:Disease {indicator_code: $code}) RETURN c.name AS country, round(sum(r.value)) AS total ORDER BY total DESC, country LIMIT 10

question: How is the reported burden of {code} split across WHO regions?
cypher: MATCH (reg:Region)<-[:IN_REGION]-(c:Country)-[:REPORTED]->(r:DiseaseReport)-[:REPORT_OF]->(d:Disease {indicator_code: $code}) RETURN reg.name AS region, round(sum(r.value)) AS total, count(DISTINCT c) AS countries ORDER BY total DESC, region

question: What was {iso}'s immunization coverage by antigen in {year}?
cypher: MATCH (c:Country {iso_code: $iso})-[:HAS_COVERAGE]->(v:VaccineCoverage) WHERE v.year = $year RETURN v.antigen AS antigen, v.coverage_pct AS coverage_pct ORDER BY antigen

question: How has {iso}'s DTP3 coverage changed since 2000?
cypher: MATCH (c:Country {iso_code: $iso})-[:HAS_COVERAGE]->(v:VaccineCoverage {antigen: 'DTP3 immunization coverage (%)'}) RETURN v.year AS year, v.coverage_pct AS coverage_pct ORDER BY year

question: Which countries had the lowest MCV1 coverage in {year}?
cypher: MATCH (c:Country)-[:HAS_COVERAGE]->(v:VaccineCoverage {antigen: 'MCV1 immunization coverage (%)'}) WHERE v.year = $year RETURN c.name AS country, v.coverage_pct AS coverage_pct ORDER BY coverage_pct ASC, country LIMIT 10

question: How has the average DTP3 coverage across countries moved year by year?
cypher: MATCH (v:VaccineCoverage {antigen: 'DTP3 immunization coverage (%)'}) RETURN v.year AS year, round(avg(v.coverage_pct)) AS avg_coverage_pct, count(v) AS countries ORDER BY year

question: In 2024, which countries had the widest gap between DTP3 and MCV1 coverage?
cypher: MATCH (c:Country)-[:HAS_COVERAGE]->(d:VaccineCoverage {antigen: 'DTP3 immunization coverage (%)'}) WHERE d.year = 2024 MATCH (c)-[:HAS_COVERAGE]->(m:VaccineCoverage {antigen: 'MCV1 immunization coverage (%)'}) WHERE m.year = 2024 RETURN c.name AS country, d.coverage_pct - m.coverage_pct AS gap ORDER BY gap DESC, country LIMIT 10

question: Which countries' DTP3 coverage fell most between 2019 and 2021?
paraphrases: Where did routine immunization slip during the pandemic?
cypher: MATCH (c:Country)-[:HAS_COVERAGE]->(a:VaccineCoverage {antigen: 'DTP3 immunization coverage (%)'}) WHERE a.year = 2019 MATCH (c)-[:HAS_COVERAGE]->(b:VaccineCoverage {antigen: 'DTP3 immunization coverage (%)'}) WHERE b.year = 2021 RETURN c.name AS country, a.coverage_pct - b.coverage_pct AS fall ORDER BY fall DESC, country LIMIT 10

question: What was the average MCV1 coverage by WHO region in {year}?
cypher: MATCH (reg:Region)<-[:IN_REGION]-(c:Country)-[:HAS_COVERAGE]->(v:VaccineCoverage {antigen: 'MCV1 immunization coverage (%)'}) WHERE v.year = $year RETURN reg.name AS region, round(avg(v.coverage_pct)) AS avg_coverage_pct, count(c) AS countries ORDER BY avg_coverage_pct DESC, region

question: What range of life expectancy at birth is recorded for {iso} in {year}?
paraphrases: How long can people in a country expect to live?
cypher: MATCH (c:Country {iso_code: $iso})-[:HAS_INDICATOR]->(h:HealthIndicator {indicator_code: 'WHOSIS_000001'}) WHERE h.year = $year RETURN round(min(h.value)) AS lowest, round(max(h.value)) AS highest, count(h) AS observations

question: Which countries recorded the highest under-five mortality in {year}?
cypher: MATCH (c:Country)-[:HAS_INDICATOR]->(h:HealthIndicator {indicator_code: 'MDG_0000000007'}) WHERE h.year = $year RETURN c.name AS country, round(max(h.value)) AS per_1000 ORDER BY per_1000 DESC, country LIMIT 10

question: Which years does indicator {code} cover?
cypher: MATCH (h:HealthIndicator {indicator_code: $code}) RETURN min(h.year) AS first_year, max(h.year) AS last_year, count(h) AS observations

question: Which countries have the lowest share of safely managed drinking water on their latest record?
cypher: MATCH (c:Country)-[:HAS_INDICATOR]->(h:HealthIndicator {indicator_code: 'WSH_WATER_SAFELY_MANAGED'}) WITH c, max(h.year) AS latest MATCH (c)-[:HAS_INDICATOR]->(h2:HealthIndicator {indicator_code: 'WSH_WATER_SAFELY_MANAGED'}) WHERE h2.year = latest RETURN c.name AS country, latest AS year, round(min(h2.value)) AS pct ORDER BY pct ASC, country LIMIT 10

question: Among countries that reported yellow fever cases, which had the lowest average MCV1 coverage?
cypher: MATCH (c:Country)-[:REPORTED]->(:DiseaseReport)-[:REPORT_OF]->(:Disease {indicator_code: 'WHS3_41'}) WITH DISTINCT c MATCH (c)-[:HAS_COVERAGE]->(v:VaccineCoverage {antigen: 'MCV1 immunization coverage (%)'}) RETURN c.name AS country, round(avg(v.coverage_pct)) AS avg_mcv1 ORDER BY avg_mcv1 ASC, country LIMIT 10

question: Which countries report on the most distinct disease indicators?
cypher: MATCH (c:Country)-[:REPORTED]->(:DiseaseReport)-[:REPORT_OF]->(d:Disease) RETURN c.name AS country, count(DISTINCT d) AS diseases ORDER BY diseases DESC, country LIMIT 10

question: How many disease reports fall in each decade?
cypher: MATCH (r:DiseaseReport) RETURN (r.year / 10) * 10 AS decade, count(r) AS reports ORDER BY decade

question: How many COVID-19 cases did each country report?
cypher: MATCH (c:Country)-[:REPORTED]->(r:DiseaseReport)-[:REPORT_OF]->(d:Disease) WHERE d.name CONTAINS 'COVID' RETURN c.name AS country, sum(r.value) AS cases

question: How many hospital beds per 1000 people does each country have?
cypher: MATCH (c:Country)-[:HAS_INDICATOR]->(h:HealthIndicator) WHERE h.name CONTAINS 'hospital beds' RETURN c.name AS country, h.value AS beds

question: Which province of India reported the most cholera cases?
cypher: MATCH (p:Province)-[:REPORTED]->(r:DiseaseReport)-[:REPORT_OF]->(:Disease {indicator_code: 'CHOLERA_0000000001'}) RETURN p.name AS province, sum(r.value) AS cases
